title: Concentration theorems for $2$-homogeneous polynomials and bilinear forms with applications to the Kadec-Klee properties
summary: We study Kadec-Klee properties in spaces of homogeneous polynomials and multilinear forms by presenting optimal results. Indeed, our main tool is a family of concentration theorems showing that, on suitable $p$-convex Banach sequence lattices, a $2$-homogeneous polynomial or a bilinear form which almost attains its norm at finitely supported vectors is uniformly close to its restriction to the corresponding finite set of coordinates.
